description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §2.12, §5.9, decision 31): the kingdom of Aldmere - its war camp, the Ballista Ridge and Fort Aldmere (members carry faction "aldmere"; P36 places them). Wary but at peace until the giant offends it: two offences within 30 s (a blow on its soldiers, damage to its engines) turn it hostile. Its own toll-riders are another faction (faction.toll_riders): breaking the toll fort does not void a parley with Aldmere.
warn_text: Aldmere's soldiers close ranks. Strike again and the kingdom is at war with you.
hostile_text: Aldmere's war horns answer: the kingdom is at war with you.
